title: docs: architect.md tells seats to read error.data.nextAction on a MoeError although error.data is exactly { tool, codeName }, and the QA landing-gap reject (qa.reference.md, moe-qa-loop) puts the held-path remedy into one issue description, which qa_reject refuses past 500 characters
description:
Defect hunt #8 (task-21d671c1), lane 3: role docs and skills checked against the runtime. HEAD b5f40fee.

PROBLEM
1. architect.md, the MoeError rule.
   - docs/roles/architect.md:30 says "On `MoeError`, read `error.data.nextAction` and do what it says." The line arrived in b4d3b91a (2026-05-08), and its vendored copy is packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts:55.
   - McpAdapter sends a MoeError as `errorResponse(id, code, message, { tool: params.name, codeName: toolError.codeName })` (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/McpAdapter.ts:316-323).
   - docs/MCP_SERVER.md:91 agrees with the code: "`error.data` is exactly `{ tool, codeName }` … `MoeError.context` is logged in the daemon and never sent, so clients key on `data.codeName` and read details from the message". For that reason, util/enforcement.ts:71-72 puts the claim call in the message text.
   - So every architect seat looks for a recovery field that never arrives, while the real next call sits in `error.message`. A retryable refusal such as TASK_NOT_CLAIMED or ATTEMPT_FINALIZING then reads as a dead end.
   - worker.md, qa.md and governor.md have no such line.
2. The QA landing-gap reject.
   - docs/roles/qa.reference.md:46-50 tells QA to call moe.qa_reject with ONE issue of type `other`. Its description starts `Landing gap:` and cites lastCommitOutcome, landingRetry, each rescue ref, and "the row's paths that are still dirty, with any held-path remedy its landing printed (`MOE_CONTESTED_HELD`)".
   - docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md:61 says the same: "the row's still-dirty paths with their remedy (`MOE_CONTESTED_HELD`)".
   - qaReject.ts:103-104 refuses any issue description over 500 characters. Neither doc mentions that cap, and MCP_SERVER.md's qa_reject section lists only reason ≤2000 and issues ≤20.
   - The remedy alone is longer than the cap: HELD_REMEDY_UNTOUCHED + HELD_REMEDY_WITNESS + HELD_REMEDY_NEVER in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/recordCommit.ts:24-30 run to about 700 characters.
   - So for a held-path landing gap, the reject the docs prescribe is refused with INVALID_INPUT, and QA truncates the evidence or stalls.

EVIDENCE
Vitest repros, run in a git-archive snapshot of HEAD (/tmp/hunt-21d6-B). Files and outputs are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-21d671c1/B/.
- errorDataNextAction.test.ts drives the real assertWorkerHoldsTask refusal through McpAdapter.handle. repro-error-data-nextAction.out shows no nextAction in data:
  `WIRE ERROR: {"code":-32002,"message":"[TASK_NOT_CLAIMED] Task task-x is not claimed by any worker, … Claim it first with moe.claim_next_task {…}","data":{"tool":"moe.start_step","codeName":"TASK_NOT_CLAIMED"}}`
- qaRejectLandingGap.test.ts builds the `Landing gap:` description exactly as the docs prescribe, with the verbatim held remedy. repro-qa-reject-landing-gap.out:
  `DESCRIPTION LENGTH: 1155` / `REFUSAL: [INVALID_INPUT] Invalid issues.description: too long (1155 chars). Maximum 500 characters.`

FIX DIRECTION
- architect.md:30: reword in place. The file is at 39 lines and `npm run lint` caps it at 40, so add no line. The new rule: on a MoeError, key on `error.data.codeName` and follow the call that `error.message` names.
- qa.reference.md (exempt from the cap) and moe-qa-loop SKILL.md:61:
  - state the 500-character cap on each issue description;
  - keep the issue to the codes, refs and paths;
  - put the printed remedy text in `reason` (max 2000) or quote it in a task comment.
  qa.md:16 lists no remedy, so it needs no change.
- Regenerate both vendored copies; see mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts:
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts (generate-init-files);
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts (generate-skill-files).
  Run the generators in a clone that has history, never as npm build/clean in the shared checkout (global rail). Apply their few-line diff hunks with the session's Edit tool, not cp: global rail on TOOL witnesses.
- qaCommitPolicy.test.ts guards the 'Landing gap:' sentinel (util/qaCommitPolicy.test.ts:31). Keep it green.

FILES: docs/roles/architect.md, docs/roles/qa.reference.md, docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md, packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts, packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts. The last two are regenerated output.
OUT OF SCOPE:
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md, held by task-66108835 and task-3e1d0c2e.
- docs/roles/qa.md.
- The using-git-worktrees skill's shared-mode-only landing text, which is held back for a later hunt.
definitionOfDone: `grep -rn 'error\.data\.nextAction' docs/roles docs/skills packages/moe-daemon/src/generated` prints nothing. architect.md's MoeError rule names `error.data.codeName` and says to follow the call that `error.message` names. `npm run lint` at the repo root passes, so architect.md stays at or under 40 lines.

`grep -n '500' docs/roles/qa.reference.md docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md` shows the issue-description cap in two places: qa.reference.md's landing-gap reject paragraph and SKILL.md's landing-gap bullet. Both route the held-path remedy text to `reason` (max 2000) or a task comment, not to the issue description.

Both vendored copies match the edited docs. In a clone of the fix commit that has history (mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts), `npm run generate-init-files && npm run generate-skill-files` leaves `git status --short src/generated` empty, and `npx vitest run src/util/initFiles.test.ts src/util/skillFiles.test.ts src/util/qaCommitPolicy.test.ts` passes.

implementationPlan.description:
architect.md:30, the MoeError rule.

In the single long line 30, replace only the sentence "On `MoeError`, read `error.data.nextAction` and do what it says." Leave the rest of the line as it is. Do not add a line: architect.md is at 39 lines, and the lint caps it at 40.

The new sentence must name `error.data.codeName` and say to follow the call that `error.message` names. Suggested: "On `MoeError`, key on `error.data.codeName` and follow the call `error.message` names (`error.data` is exactly `{ tool, codeName }`)."

Why: McpAdapter.ts:316-323 sends exactly { tool, codeName }, and docs/MCP_SERVER.md:91 documents it.

Edit with the session's own editor: Edit on Claude, apply_patch on codex exec. Never use Serena (its project config ignores docs/) or a shell write; that is the global rail on TOOL witnesses.

Error handling: if your editor's match fails, re-read the line and retry the exact sentence. Never rewrite the whole file. The tests for this step are in the step 4 gate (the grep for data.nextAction, plus the lint).

Add the QA landing-gap cap to qa.reference.md and moe-qa-loop SKILL.md, editing both with the same tool rule as step 1.

(a) qa.reference.md, the 'The reject.' paragraph (:46-50).
- Keep the opening sentence and the four bullets.
- Change the last bullet so it names the dirty paths and any held-path code (`MOE_CONTESTED_HELD`) without the full remedy text.
- Add one sentence after the bullets: `moe.qa_reject` refuses an issue description longer than 500 characters (qaReject.ts:103-104). So keep that issue to the codes, refs and paths, and put the held-path remedy text the landing printed in `reason` (max 2000 characters) or quote it in a task comment.

(b) docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md:61, the landing-gap bullet.
- Make the same change in place: "…still-dirty paths with their held-path code (`MOE_CONTESTED_HELD`)".
- Add the 500-character cap, with the remedy routed to `reason` or a comment.

Do not touch qa.md (out of scope).

Keep every phrase util/qaCommitPolicy.test.ts pins, in both files:
- 'Landing gap:'
- 'lastCommitOutcome'
- 'in either mode'
- 'counts toward the reopen cap'
- 'bounded wait, not a blocker'
- 'up to ~2 minutes'
- 'record_commit'
- '#governors'
- 'MOE_AGENT_GIT_REFUSED'
And add none of its RETIRED phrases: 'land it yourself', 'shared mode only', and the rest.

Error handling: '500' appears nowhere in either file today, so the DoD 2 grep proves exactly this addition. The tests for this step are the qaCommitPolicy run in the step 4 gate.

Regenerate the vendored copies and apply their hunks (see mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts).

What changes:
- packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts vendors both edited role docs: architect.md and qa.reference.md. Each entry's body changes, and so does its sha-stamped marker. Each doc's shipped-body sha list gains one sha, kept sorted.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts vendors moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md: its embedded body changes and so does its frontmatter marker sha.

Generate them outside the shared checkout, in a clone that has history. A git-archive snapshot writes truncated sha lists. Run from your worktree:
`S=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q --shared "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" $S/r && git -C $S/r checkout -q $(git rev-parse HEAD) && cp --parents docs/roles/{architect.md,qa.reference.md} docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md $S/r`
Then, in `$S/r/packages/moe-daemon`, under the step 4 env -i PATH, run:
`npm ci --no-audit && npm run -s generate-init-files && npm run -s generate-skill-files`
Both must print a `Generated …` line. A 'skipping' line means the docs were missing: stop and fix the clone.

Then `diff -u` each regenerated file against your worktree's copy, and apply every hunk with your editor (Edit or apply_patch). Do not cp it over: the global rail requires a TOOL witness. Expect a few small hunks per entry; recent rows show about 6 changed lines per role doc.

Never run npm build, ci or clean in the shared checkout (global rail).

Error handling: if a hunk will not match, re-run the diff against your current file and apply that hunk again. The step 4 gate proves the result byte for byte with its regenerate-and-checksum compare.

Verification: run this one command, exactly, from the task worktree. It is the complete_task evidence, and the same command is checkRefs[0].

`cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && S=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q --shared "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" $S/r && git -C $S/r checkout -q $(git rev-parse HEAD) && cp --parents docs/roles/{architect.md,qa.reference.md} docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/{initFiles,skillFiles}.ts $S/r && cd $S/r && ! grep -rq 'data\.nextAction' docs/roles docs/skills packages/moe-daemon/src/generated && grep -q 500 docs/roles/qa.reference.md && grep -q 500 docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md && env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NO_COLOR=1 bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npm run -s lint && cd packages/moe-daemon && npm ci --no-audit >/dev/null 2>&1 && sha1sum src/generated/*.ts > ../g.sha && npm run -s generate-init-files | grep Generated && npm run -s generate-skill-files | grep Generated && sha1sum -c --quiet ../g.sha && npx vitest run src/util/{initFiles,skillFiles,qaCommitPolicy}.test.ts | grep -aE "Test Files|Tests |FAIL"'`

What it checks, in order:
- DoD 1 and DoD 2: the content greps, then the role-doc lint (40-line cap).
- DoD 3: regenerating from the edited docs must leave both vendored files byte-identical to yours.
- Then the three guard test files.

Expected: OK lint lines, two Generated lines, `Test Files  3 passed (3)`, exit 0.

Measured while planning:
- On HEAD f8b8d60c it exits 1 at the data.nextAction grep (architect.md:30 and initFiles.ts:55).
- With the content greps removed, the rest passed on HEAD: 3 files, 44 tests, about 42 s.

Error handling for a red run:
- A sha1sum 'FAILED' line means your hand-applied hunks differ from the generator's output. Redo step 3's diff.
- A qaCommitPolicy failure names the sentinel phrase you dropped.
- Re-run the whole command; never submit a subset as evidence.

Adversarial self-review of this row's own diff. Load adversarial-self-review, then check:
1. architect.md is still at or under 40 lines (lint OK), and its rule no longer promises any error field the daemon never sends.
2. The new QA text does not contradict qa.md:16 or the 'A second landing gap is not rejected again' rule in SKILL.md:61, which stays as it is.
3. Every qaCommitPolicy sentinel is still present in both the docs and their vendored copies.
4. The vendored copies were not hand-written: the gate's checksum compare is the proof.
5. `git status --short` in the worktree lists only the 5 files.
6. No added line contains any string from the project.json globalRails.forbiddenPatterns list.
Fix anything this finds, then re-run the step 4 command before complete_task.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: architect.md's MoeError rule tells seats to key on error.data.codeName (error.data is exactly { tool, codeName }) and to follow the call error.message names. It no longer points at error.data.nextAction, which the daemon never sends. The QA landing-gap reject docs state qa_reject's 500-character cap on an issue description and route the held-path remedy text to reason (max 2000) or a task comment. The vendored initFiles.ts and skillFiles.ts match the edited docs byte for byte.
invariants: architect.md stays at or under 40 lines; npm run lint passes.
Every qaCommitPolicy.test.ts sentinel phrase stays in qa.reference.md, SKILL.md and their vendored copies, and no RETIRED phrase returns.
The generated files are the generators' exact output; the regenerate-and-checksum compare in checkRefs[0] proves it.
compatibility: No daemon runtime code changes, only vendored doc strings.
The daemon's marker-sha upgrade rewrites stale .moe/roles and .moe/skills copies at its next start; that is the normal path.
checkRefs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && S=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q --shared "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" $S/r && git -C $S/r checkout -q $(git rev-parse HEAD) && cp --parents docs/roles/{architect.md,qa.reference.md} docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/{initFiles,skillFiles}.ts $S/r && cd $S/r && ! grep -rq 'data\.nextAction' docs/roles docs/skills packages/moe-daemon/src/generated && grep -q 500 docs/roles/qa.reference.md && grep -q 500 docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md && env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NO_COLOR=1 bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npm run -s lint && cd packages/moe-daemon && npm ci --no-audit >/dev/null 2>&1 && sha1sum src/generated/*.ts > ../g.sha && npm run -s generate-init-files | grep Generated && npm run -s generate-skill-files | grep Generated && sha1sum -c --quiet ../g.sha && npx vitest run src/util/{initFiles,skillFiles,qaCommitPolicy}.test.ts | grep -aE "Test Files|Tests |FAIL"'

approachesConsidered: Changing McpAdapter to send nextAction in error.data: rejected. It changes the documented wire contract (MCP_SERVER.md:91), and the epic rail forbids MCP contract breaks.
Raising qa_reject's 500-char cap: rejected. The cap bounds stored issue data, and reason already allows 2000 characters.
Editing docs/MCP_SERVER.md's qa_reject section: out of scope, because rows 66108835 and 3e1d0c2e hold that file.
codebaseInsights: docs/roles/*.md, including the .reference.md files, are vendored into src/generated/initFiles.ts with a sha marker and a shipped-body sha list built from git history plus the working copy. docs/skills/** are vendored into src/generated/skillFiles.ts.
Both generators exit 0 with a 'skipping' line when the docs are absent. The gate therefore greps for 'Generated'.
A git-archive snapshot lacks history and writes truncated shipped-body lists, so the gate uses a --shared clone checked out at the worktree's HEAD, with the 5 edited files overlaid.
risks: Hand-applied generated hunks that drift by one byte; the gate's checksum compare catches this.
Dropping a qaCommitPolicy sentinel while rewording.
Adding a line to architect.md (lint cap).
The gate needs network or an npm cache for npm ci in the clone.
